description: This PHP class CandidateAttachmentDecorator adds behavior to the CandidateAttachment entity, providing methods for retrieving file content and associating a candidate by ID within the context of the OrangeHRM human resource management system.

classes.name: CandidateAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for CandidateAttachment providing additional functionality such as file content retrieval and associating candidates by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a CandidateAttachment entity.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the attachment, reading from the resource stream if necessary.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with the attachment based on the provided candidate ID.
